```
took 45.3223ms
```


Does running
`C:\Users\user\.volta\bin\node.EXE --version` manually work for you?

```C:\Users\user\.volta\bin\node.exe --version``` works
```C:\Users\user\.volta\bin\node.EXE --version``` does not work

the found location indeed is my VOLTA_HOME directory including volta's shims to startup the appropriate node environments. 
This setup used to work perfectly with starship until version 0.47

It looks like volta is checking from what path it is called from, but it's failing to account for the `exe` being capitalised, even though it looks like this is how it is present in the file system. I suggest you try taking this issue upstream.

The change in behaviour is likely happening because starship will now try to resolve the full paths to external commands instead of executing by the command name (`node`) in order support executable files on windows other than exe. (#2019)

A temporary fix might be to rename the executable from `node.EXE` to `node.exe`.
interestingly the actual filename is ``` C:\Users\user\.volta\bin\node.exe```, so i cannot rename it. will open up an issue at [volta](https://github.com/volta-cli/volta)
Have closed this since it is an upstream issue and looks like it should be fixed in their next release.
